body: Our GeN-G team joined 25 fourth graders at Camelot Intermediate School for Educator for a Day. Students examined sick plants and decoded LEGO DNA sequences with Brickopore and Monster Maker.

Congratulations to Israel Akinlabi on receiving the student translational team grant coordinated by the Borlaug Global Rust Initiative (BGRI)! The grant will allow Israel to expand his research on wheat stem rust in collaboration with CIMMYT Kenya. We are so proud of him!
title: Global Wheat Health Alliance Translational Team Grant

body: The Solanki Lab, in collaboration with colleagues across South Dakota State University, received a National Science Foundation Major Research Instrumentation (MRI) grant to bring an Illumina NextSeq 2000 to SDSU’s Genomics Sequencing Facility. The new sequencer will expand opportunities for functional genomics research and hands-on student training at SDSU.
